claims.content: System Operator
An emergency condition exists that requires search and rescue efforts.
A previously reported emergency point exists.
The JU has additional or more current information on the point.
A J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is received on an emergency point, declaring the unit with R² inactive.
No periodic update is received for three consecutive update intervals.

The System Operator initiates reporting through operator action only when the JU has additional or more current information on a previously reported emergency point, or when a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is received or no periodic update is received for three consecutive update intervals.

trigger.raw_text: The System Operator initiates reporting through operator action only when the JU has additional or more current information on a previously reported emergency point, or when a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is received or no periodic update is received for three consecutive update intervals.

claims.content: The System Operator initiates the report through operator action only.
The system transmits a J3.1 Emergency Point message.
The system uses the same TN Reference and the same value of TN Previously Reported as those reported by the previous reporting unit.
The system reports the position using geodetic latitude/longitude values.
The system reports the time associated with the reported point.

The system transmits IFF/SIF data (Modes I, II, and III Codes) in the J3.1 message when available, containing the IFF/SIF modes and codes of the previously reported track for which the emergency point was initiated.

If a JU without R² desires that a specific point, line, or area be transmitted immediately without awaiting the next periodic update, it should transmit a J7.1 (ACT = 1) Data Update Request for the desired TN.
If a JU fails to receive the J7.0 (ACT = 0) message and further updates are not received, the JU may purge those points after a specified time period has elapsed with no updates.
A JU receiving a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message on a point, line, or area shall not be required to purge the point, line, or area.

However, if the JU does not purge a point, line, or area on which it has received a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message, it shall assume R² for the point, line, or area to ensure that it remains active on the interface.
A JU shall not transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message on a point when the point becomes an Active IU on the interface with the same TN.
When a remote point, line, or area is purged from a system by local options, a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message shall not be transmitted.
The latest JU to report a point has R² for that point.
The point is assigned a TN and the position is reported using geodetic latitude/longitude values.
If assuming R², the system uses the same TN Reference and the same value of TN Previously Reported as those reported by the previous reporting unit.
No alert indicators are used for the J3.1 Emergency Point message.
